highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.3 integrates upstream fixes for image filtering, glyph rendering and GPU allocation safety.
highlights_body: This servicing update keeps the managed API and native C ABI unchanged.

bullets.lead: Cleaner image filters and bounded destination reads
bullets.detail: Ganesh image filtering avoids mipmaps that could incorporate unwritten scratch-texture contents. Draws that read the destination are clipped to their destination-read bounds, including when geometry overshoots calculated draw bounds.

bullets.lead: Correct glyph cropping and painter order
bullets.detail: FreeType LCD16 glyph copies use consistent pixel-space bounds and crop to the valid overlap when successive loads produce different outlines. Graphite resets depth and bounds tracking after overwriting draws so depth wrap does not reorder rendering.

Checked alignment and size arithmetic prevents overflowing allocation requests and out-of-bounds padding writes. Invalid or failed allocations skip the draw rather than proceeding with an invalid buffer.
